title: Follow up after a week
text: If you haven't heard back after about a week, send a short, polite email asking if they need anything else from you.

title: Match the ad
text: Use the same words as the job ad in your resume and cover letter. If they ask for 'customer service', say 'customer service'.

title: Keep a copy
text: Save a copy of every job ad you apply for. Ads often disappear once they close, and you'll want it before an interview.

title: Practise out loud
text: Say your answers to common interview questions out loud, not just in your head. It feels odd, but it works.

title: Ask a question back
text: At the end of an interview, ask one question, like 'What does a good first month look like?' It shows you're keen.

title: Quality over quantity
text: Five applications written for the job beat twenty copied ones. Change your first paragraph for every application.

title: Check your voicemail
text: Employers often call. Make sure your voicemail message is clear and friendly, and check it every day.

title: Say thank you
text: Send a short thank-you message after an interview. It's rare enough that people remember it.
